summary: 2200M prints both pages faithfully and spells out region/province/city, but a schedule Tax Rate cell renders its value as crushed unreadable microtext, the Part IV screen cards leak a developer fixture path, and a schedule volume field silently corrupts a typed decimal into a 100x larger number.

defects.where: Page 2, Schedule 1 - continuation, XM060 'Other Metallic Minerals' rows 1-2, column (I) Tax Rate
defects.what: The Tax Rate value is printed as a vertical sliver of ~4px microtext (e.g. '4,321,098.76' is rendered crushed and rotated) while every neighbouring cell prints normally; the cell is blank-white on the official sheet so users write any rate there.

defects.where: Form page, Part IV - Details of Payment, items 25-28 cards
defects.what: Each card shows developer text leaking a repo fixture path: 'No box: the official program keeps Part IV disabled (rules/forms/2200m-v2018/fixtures/runtime-control-inventory-v796.json: disabled at load) and this app never writes it; the bank or BIR fills it.' Same defect family as 2200C C2.

defects.where: Form page, Part V Schedule 1, XM010 row 2 'Volume Removed (MT): Taxable' input
defects.what: Typed '9,876,543.21' by hand; the field stored 987,654,321 (decimal point silently dropped) and the printed sheet shows 987,654,321.00 - a 100x overstatement of the amount the user typed. A neighbouring amount field accepted the same comma+decimal format correctly.

The runtime accepts 26 schedule rows but the sheet (and the UI) only shows the 10 paper rows; rows 11-26 filled via payload are silently dropped from print with no sign. Not reachable by typing in the UI today (rows are fixed), so a user cannot hit it through the page alone.

defects.where: Page 1, item 19 Payment on Returns Previously Filed
defects.what: Prints '0.00' in the comb for an unset amount (the lone-zero pattern seen on 2200A item 19).

entered_by_hand: Part III item 17A 'Balance Carried Over from Previous Return' typed as 9,999,888.77 (printed correctly); Part V XM010 row 2 'Place of Removal' typed as 'SITE BRAVO 2' (printed correctly) and 'Volume Removed Taxable' typed as 9,876,543.21 which the field corrupted to 987,654,321.00 (defect M3).
checked_by_hand: Re-opened the saved draft, re-opened print preview and Save as PDF, and re-inspected the XM060 continuation column and row-2 volume cell at zoom after the first pass; M1, M2 and M3 reproduced on the second look.
notes: Places of Production/Removal (items 10 and 11) print spelled-out names (NCR / NCR SECOND DISTRICT / CITY OF MAKATI), matching 2200AN rather than the raw PSGC codes of 2200A/2200C. Item 16 total equals the sum of the printed continuation column L only; dropped rows 11-26 do not corrupt it. Part IV (items 25-28) has no fillable fields at all and prints blank, same as 2200C.
